card.title: IPhone XS Freezes When Last Digit of Pin Code is Entered

source.title: IPhone XS Freezes When Last Digit of Pin Code is Entered

symptoms: freezes at last passcode digit then restarts

claims.statement: On iPhone XS / XS Max the passcode freeze is usually a sandwich issue: reball or bottom board swap; without transferring NFC expect a 10–20 min 'Attempting Data Recovery'.

procedure: Reball sandwich or swap bottom board.
Allow data recovery screen to finish.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
